verdict.rationale: Navan's in-product AI assistant Ava is described as analyzing real-time spend data, providing insights into T&E questions, and proactively suggesting savings. It also summarizes spend, compares it to policy, and predicts future spend, which covers both the insights and the suggestions parts of the story. The MCP server is an external-assistant route, not an in-product feature, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Ava beyond a launch blog post, and independent or hands-on corroboration that its insights and suggestions work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ava slices and dices real-time spend data, provides insights into T&E questions, and proactively finds opportunities for savings.
